# STY002 `program-with-module`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A file defines both a program and a module.

## Why

A module in the same file as a program cannot be used by anything else without compiling the
program too, and the file mixes a library with its driver. Keep modules in their own files.

## Reported

```fortran
module helpers
end module helpers
program main
end program main
```

## Preferred

```fortran
! helpers.f90 holds the module, main.f90 the program
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY002] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY002` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S212` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
